payload.blocks: Setting the plan done at the end (criterion 7). Phase 5 continues meanwhile.
payload.headline: Criterion 7: count `plan-contract-check --all` as met once every status is plan-v1, though other plans still fail it?

parts.cause: Criterion 7 was written as 'exits 0 with all plans adhering to the plan-v1 enum'; the check also fails on missing sections and active overlaps, which belong to other plans' leads and the supervisor. The owner's scope for other plans (q-wb6bdz3c72) is status and contract lines only.

options.does: Criterion 7 is read as the status vocabulary; the lead records the remaining errors in the plan and the secretary opens one backlog row for the other plans' owners.
options.gain: This plan can finish when phase 5 lands.
options.harm: --all stays red until those plans are fixed.
options.label: Count it met (recommended)

options.does: This plan stays running until the other plans and the overlaps are fixed by their owners.
options.harm: The plan's end depends on work outside it.
options.label: Wait for a clean --all

parts.recommendation: Count criterion 7 met on the status vocabulary and open one backlog row for the three plans' missing sections and the active overlaps.

scope.allows: Reading criterion 7 as the status vocabulary; recording the remaining errors.
scope.forbids: Editing other plans' content or footprints from this plan.

parts.what: Phase 7 landed (05904d7e2): every plan status is now plan-v1 and a non-plan-v1 status fails --all. But --all still exits 1 on errors this plan does not own: 261118-1117-external-ui-integration-multica (no sections, bad source), 261121-0819-rotation-soft-and-npm-reds and 261121-0851-rotation-successor-launch (missing owner-questions section, bad blockedBy), and 6 footprint overlaps among active plans (s6a-execution-tier-rust, work-data-model, git-windows-custody, windows-ci-packaging-reds).
